name: Can I do a 1031 exchange if I want to buy multiple properties?

mainEntity.name: Can I do a 1031 exchange if I want to buy multiple properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a 1031 exchange allows for the acquisition of multiple replacement properties, provided they meet the "like-kind" criteria and you adhere to the identification rules. You can identify up to three properties of any value (the 3-property rule) or identify more than three properties if their total fair market value does not exceed 200% of the relinquished property's value (the 200% rule). This flexibility offers a decision factor for investors looking to diversify or scale their real estate holdings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can acquire multiple replacement properties in a 1031 exchange, adhering to specific identification rules like the 3-property or 200% rule.
